---
title: "Trialblazer Solutions"
---


```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)

trailblazer <- read_csv("slides/data/trailblazer21.csv")

trailblazer |>  
  pivot_longer( #make data longer
    cols = -Player, #bring all cols but Player down
    names_to = "Game", #name the col Game
    values_to = "Points", #name the values col Points
  ) |> 
  separate_wider_delim(Game , delim = "_", names = c("Game" , "Location")) |> 
  mutate(Game = fct_relevel(Game, 
    "Game1", "Game2", "Game3", "Game4", "Game5",
    "Game6", "Game7", "Game8", "Game9", "Game10"
  )) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(x = Game, y = Points, color = Location, group = 1)
  ) + 
  geom_line(color = "gray70") + 
  geom_point(size = 3) + 
  facet_wrap(~Player) + 
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Home" = "steelblue",
      "Away" = "darkorange"
    )
  ) + 
  labs(title = "TrailBlazers Player Performance Across Games",
       x = "Game",
       y = "Points Scored",
       color = "Location") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```
